mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, s.full_name AS student_name, u.full_name AS reporter_name FROM behavior_incidents i JOIN students s ON s.id = i.student_id JOIN users u ON u.id = i.reported_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_incidents (student_id, reported_by, incident_date, location, description, severity, action_taken, parent_visible) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{reportedBy}, #{incidentDate}, #{location}, #{description}, #{severity}, #{actionTaken}, #{parentVisible})

WHERE i.student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM teacher_student WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId})
